# add-parameter

Add a request parameter or response property to a Custom API

## Usage

```
ppds custom-apis add-parameter [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api-name` | yes | Custom API unique name or GUID |
| `param-name` | yes | Unique parameter name |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--description` |  | `string` |  | Optional description |
| `--direction` |  | `string` |  | Direction: input or output |
| `--display-name` |  | `string` |  | Display name (defaults to param-name) |
| `--entity` |  | `string` |  | Logical entity name (required for Entity, EntityCollection, EntityReference types) |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--optional` |  | `bool` |  | Mark the parameter as optional (input parameters only) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--type` |  | `string` |  | Data type: Boolean, DateTime, Decimal, Entity, EntityCollection, EntityReference, Float, Integer, Money, Picklist, String, StringArray, or Guid |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
